title: The Hoarfrost Hermit
text: A hermit made half of ice lives in a cave of frost, one side of him a man and the other side clear and glittering, his heart visible through it, beating slow. The storm screams outside. He offers you shelter, and his breath does not steam.

options.label: Shelter with the half-frozen man, and trust that his ice does not spread.

outcomes.text: The night is cold but safe. His heart beats slowly in the dark, and you count it until dawn.
It is colder than you thought. By morning, a little of the ice is in you too.

options.label: The wisest asks how he became so, and how to keep from following.

outcomes.text: He gives a warning, along with a way to keep the cold from the heart.

options.label: Push on through the storm, rather than sleep beside a heart of ice.

outcomes.text: You get through frostbitten, with toes that will not warm for days.
